title: merge-when-green updates a PR behind its base and waits for its new checks
goal: merge-when-green never merges a PR whose green checks ran against an older base
acceptance: Without a merge queue, a green PR whose head is behind its base (GitHub compare, behind_by) is updated through update-branch with expected_head_sha, never force-pushed, and merged only after the new head checks pass
A compare GitHub does not answer never merges; ten failures of a kind in a row give up with exit 1
Failing and pending checks, conflicts and the merge queue behave as before
A test that failed on the pre-fix tool, committed before the fix
privacy: Tool and test text only; no personal data.
escalation: Turning on strict branch protection or a merge queue is a repository setting: ask the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one guard in the tool, a fixture test, two doc lines. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-26; verification is the merged PR green CI.
